propositions: Snapshot-GC worker lock at <snapshot-store>/gc/worker.lock is not included in doctor lock census, making it invisible to diagnostics when the worker process dies between acquire and release
Doctor lock census must add snapshot-gc-worker leg using read-only derivation to avoid creating directories as side effects of the diagnostic pass
Snapshot-GC worker lock uses the same v2 stamped ownership format as drain and compact-worker locks, enabling staleness adjudication via the shared lock_owner.stamped_file_is_stale table
Snapshot store root derivation requires a non-creating peek_store_root() function to respect the read-only guarantee of diagnostic operations
Absent snapshot store should report the leg as free with no lock holder to match behavior of absent lock files in other legs
Doctor lock census schema and test coverage must be updated to recognize the new snapshot-gc-worker leg as a sixth leg with per-host rather than tracker-adjacent scope
